data.one_liner: Relative time formatting for Dart and Flutter supporting 22 locales and CLDR plurals.
data.what_it_does: Turns a DateTime into relative text like "just now", "5 minutes ago", or "in 3 days". It runs in both Flutter and plain Dart with an injectable clock and multiple style options.
use_when: You need relative timestamps in feeds, chats, notifications, or logs.
You require correct CLDR plural rules for multiple languages.
You need to run relative time formatting in pure Dart outside of Flutter.
avoid_when: You need calendar phrasing like "yesterday" or "last week".
You need multi-unit durations such as "2 hours 5 minutes".
strengths: Supports 22 locales with CLDR plurals and fallback mechanisms.
Injectable clock for deterministic tests and server-corrected time.
Provides nextChange helper for efficient UI refresh scheduling.
weaknesses: Occitan is restricted to long style due to lack of CLDR data.
Months are fixed to 30 days and years to 365 days.
